comment: Round 20 evidence - lvai_run_vi_and_read_values(backend=pylabview) on the top-level VI, verbatim value blocks. Two-point verification against hand-computed values; both passed bit-for-bit. via=ActiveX, runMs=3 both times.
whyThisProvesTheCallsAreWired: If a Call were silently empty (the LV014 trap) Sum/Count would read their indicator defaults (0) for both inputs, and Mean would be 0/0. Two DIFFERENT inputs producing two different hand-computed outputs couples N in through the pane AND Sum/Count/Mean back out - both Call directions measured live.
